text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, after Wonder Acute has a
number of
victories under her belt...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I ask her to meet me in front of the
station, but I
keep our final destination a
secret.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Anyway... I made sure to prepare since
we're
going out.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
But what's with this yellow bus? This isn't
the one
we usually take to racecourses.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
A hot spring? You mean like some kind
of hot
spring race?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
A hot spring trip?! Then, what you're
saying is...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I can take it easy and rest for a while?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute freezes for a moment
before
reacting with glee.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Wooow! How wonderful. Thank you so
much,
dearie.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You wanted to make me happy by
surprising me
with a "baecay," yes? How
very thoughtful.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Uh, I'm guessing that she means
"vacay." But,
yes, I want to give her a
vacation...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two of us head out on a
leisurely trip
together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Soaking in the hot spring...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh... Trainer, this place is just
heavenly.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Why, my body is so warm and steamy
now...
Mmm, I could get used to this.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems like Wonder Acute really
enjoyed the
bath.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That outdoor bath was a real blessing for
these
old knees. The warmth spread
through my whole
body.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I could just melt away... Thank you for
this trip,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
And while I was soaking, I got a chance
to say so
many things.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Did she happen to meet someone in the
hot
spring? Curious, I ask her to
elaborate.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, not to any person. I was
communicating with
all the parts of my
body.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
My hands, my legs, my back... I thanked
them all
properly for all their hard work.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
They're awful weary after all those races,
you
know.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's why it's important to let them
know how
much they're appreciated.
They're the ones
enduring all that pain
and all those injuries, after
all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if the appreciation she has for
her body
is a factor behind Wonder
Acute's longevity.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just as she does her utmost to care for
her body, I
want to do the same for her.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...Are you sure? You don't even want me
to go for
a light jog?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oho... Thank you, dearie...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I think I'll have myself a
little nature
walk tomorrow. I've always
wanted to do one of
those.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, the next day...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Take a gander at these grasshoppers
over here.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
They're all hopping along so happily.

Good for you, little ones...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Is that a babbling brook I hear?
Isn't that
just the most pleasant sound?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
If only this moment could last forever.
Ahhh... ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I simply smile and watch on as a carefree
Wonder
Acute recuperates.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I sense that Wonder Acute and I have
formed an
irreplaceable bond during this
time together.
